categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in research, development, and precision manufacturing of interconnection products. Main business segments include: (1) Data storage interconnection products and components (SATA, DDR4, SD, CF, Type C, USB3.0 connectors and high-speed data cables); (2) Consumer electronics interconnection products and components (battery connectors, HDMI, SSL, Type C, USB connectors, and data cables); (3) Communications interconnection products and components (high-speed backplane connectors and RF connectors); (4) New energy precision connectors and structural components (battery box systems, copper busbars, high/low voltage connectors). The company also generates revenue from other business activities including scrap material sales and equipment rental.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: innovative new product development, precision metal stamping mold design and processing, precision plastic mold design and processing, precision machining, customized surface treatment, automation technology, high-precision product system testing, and intelligent composite manufacturing. Manufacturing methods employ precision stamping, injection molding, and automated assembly processes. The company utilizes advanced CAE simulation technology (structural analysis, stress analysis, fatigue analysis, electrical and high-frequency analysis, thermal analysis, motion analysis, metal forming analysis, and mold flow analysis) with analysis accuracy exceeding 90%. The company has established systematic product testing systems covering mechanical, electrical, and environmental performance aspects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major international and domestic companies such as SK Hynix (晟碟半导体), Molex (莫仕), Star Semiconductor (星科金朋), Xiaomi ecosystem companies, Romoss (罗马仕), Anker Innovation (安克创新), and Woke Fanfan (沃客非凡). The company serves multiple end markets: data storage (hard drives, SSDs, memory cards), consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, power banks, chargers), 5G communications (base stations, data centers), and new energy vehicles (EV batteries, charging systems). The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with these leading customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province. Key manufacturing facilities include: Shenzhen (headquarters and R&D center), Huizhou (major production facility through subsidiary Huizhou Chuangyitong), Hubei Province (Anlu city through subsidiary Hubei Chuangyitong), and Guangxi Province (Liuzhou through subsidiary Liuzhou Pengwei). International presence includes subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Malaysia (Penang). Domestic sales account for 87.92% of revenue while exports represent 12.08%, with products shipped globally to customers in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the electronics supply chain. It functions as a precision component manufacturer and supplier, positioned between raw material suppliers (metals, plastics, electronic components) and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers. The company handles design, engineering, precision manufacturing, quality control, and direct sales to customers. It does not perform upstream mining or material refining, nor does it engage in final product assembly for end consumers, maintaining focus on precision interconnection components and structural parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus emphasizes: (1) High-speed interconnection products as the core business; (2) Expansion into new application domains including 5G communications, new energy vehicles, and IoT; (3) Continuous technology innovation in miniaturization, high-speed transmission, and multi-functionality; (4) Development of advanced manufacturing capabilities including automation and intelligent production; (5) Market expansion through new customer acquisition while deepening relationships with existing major customers; (6) Capacity expansion through the Huizhou industrial park project to support growth. R&D priorities include USB 4.0 cables, automotive Type-C connectors, high-current power connectors for EVs, medical-grade connectors, and advanced manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products. Revenue recognition occurs when customers obtain control of goods, typically at delivery or customer acceptance. For domestic sales, revenue is recognized upon customer signature/acceptance or upon delivery to customer-specified locations, with some VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) arrangements recognizing revenue when goods reach the customer's factory. For export sales, revenue is recognized upon customs clearance and shipment (FOB/FCA terms) or upon delivery to specified locations (DAP/DDP terms). The company also generates secondary revenue from scrap material sales and equipment rental. Payment terms typically range from 30-90 days after delivery. The company does not offer significant financing arrangements or extended payment terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international leaders such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol, and Molex, which have established Chinese manufacturing bases. Domestic competitors include other listed connector manufacturers that have accumulated advantages in technology, scale production, and customer resources. The company differentiates itself through: (1) Specialization in high-speed interconnection products and data storage applications where it achieves international-level technical capabilities; (2) Strong R&D and rapid product development cycles (20-30 days for connectors, 10-20 days for data cables); (3) Customized solutions and deep customer partnerships; (4) Advanced precision manufacturing capabilities with mold technology at industry-leading levels. The company holds a strong position in data storage connectors and is expanding market share in consumer electronics and emerging segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of RMB 689.4 million, representing 27.31% year-over-year growth from RMB 541.5 million in 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was RMB 19.7 million in 2024, up 74.04% from RMB 11.3 million in 2023. Total assets reached RMB 1,357.6 million at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of RMB 641.0 million. The company demonstrates strong growth momentum with expanding profitability. Operating cash flow was RMB 7.9 million in 2024 (down from RMB 57.3 million in 2023 due to working capital increases). The company is in a growth phase with significant capacity expansion underway through the Huizhou industrial park project.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) High-speed, high-precision interconnection solutions meeting stringent performance requirements for data storage and communications applications; (2) Rapid product development and customization capabilities enabling customers to accelerate time-to-market; (3) Reliable quality and consistency through advanced manufacturing processes and comprehensive testing systems; (4) Cost optimization through efficient design and manufacturing, helping customers reduce product costs; (5) Long-term partnership approach with deep customer integration in product development; (6) Comprehensive product portfolio spanning multiple connector types and applications; (7) International-standard quality certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO13485, GJB9001C) and industry recognitions (Apple MFi, USB 3.1 certification). The company emphasizes technical excellence, reliability, and customer-centric innovation as core differentiators in a competitive market.
